text:
Maya (CSM): Quick thread 
Team — HorizonCorp dedicated bring-up next week. Need final quota rows, autoscale policy, and a concise soak plan. Renewal check is in two weeks; we'd like clean T+72h metrics.
Arun (Solutions Eng): Copy. What's the steady vs burst we should validate?
Zoe (SRE): Recommend baseline 120 qps, steady 320 qps, short bursts 750 qps (1-3m). Tests: quick smoke (3m), ramp (15m), soak (30m).
Arun (Solutions Eng): I'll run KV/prefix prime 24h before ramp and a light warmup 2h prior. Will share scripts.
Lee (Support): I'll be on-call for the window. Post any alert thresholds and Ill assemble a 1-page triage doc.
Zoe (SRE): Alerts: error_rate > 1% for 60s -> notify; p95 > 650ms for 90s -> scale; p99 > 1200ms -> page. Fallback rule: route to quantized-small if p95 > 850ms for 60s.
Arun (Solutions Eng): Load command I'll use:

```
./rps-fire --target https://staging.api.redwood/horizon --rps 320 --duration 30m --pattern ramp --hdr "x-account:horizon"
```

Arun (Solutions Eng): KV priming:

```
python tools/priming.py --acct horizon --prompts horizon_seed.json --concurrency 6
```

Zoe (SRE): Autoscale draft:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  target: 420
  eval_window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 90
```

Maya (CSM): I'll message the renewal owner and prepare the enablement deck + 1-question feedback card. We'll mark HorizonCorp high-touch for 10 days post-go-live.
Lee (Support): I'll post the support playbook link here and wire CSAT to send at T+48h.
ops-bot: deployment window reserved 2024-11-03T02:00Z ticket CS-9987 :white_check_mark:
Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Arun: drop scripts + metrics link. 2) Zoe: commit autoscale policy + runbook path. 3) Lee: publish support playbook + CSAT. 4) Maya: send renewal note + enablement. Ping when done. :thumbsup:
